purpose: Bind the read-only Habitat Gate to the NOHAND Habitat Terminal so the Terminal can request bounded file discovery from Gate, receive an attested path/fingerprint handoff, and then use the Terminal's existing guarded COPY_TO_GIT path for export.

properties: inbox branch is pinned to an immutable commit SHA per cycle
runtime audit fuse blocks destructive process actions
static source scan rejects destructive primitives
source and safety contract are re-verified during runtime
handoff carries path,size,mtime_ns,st_dev,st_ino,sha256 when within hash budget
handoff is observation only and authority_weight is zero

terminal_candidate.behavior: GATE_FIND is observation. Export remains a separate existing COPY_TO_GIT mutation-of-Git action and therefore retains Guardian/Beacon/DemiHead barriers.

exchange.discovery_flow: TERMINAL_GUARD -> BEACON_FORECAST(GATE_FIND) -> CREATE_ONLY_GATE_REQUEST_V2 -> GATE_PINNED_COMMIT_READ -> GATE_READONLY_SCAN -> HASH_BOUND_HANDOFF -> TERMINAL_VALIDATES_GATE_AND_HANDOFF -> BEACON_SETTLE
exchange.export_flow: SELECT_HANDOFF_PATH -> TERMINAL_COPY_TO_GIT -> TERMINAL_GUARD -> BEACON_FORECAST -> DEMIHEAD_LOCAL_TO_GIT_BARRIER -> SENTINEL_WATCH -> EXACT_LOCAL_HASH -> CREATE_ONLY_GIT_COPY -> BEACON_SETTLE -> DEMIHEAD_OUTCOME

next_gate: replace janus_habitat_gate.py on NAS with exact v1.4 candidate
replace janus_habitat_terminal.py on NAS with exact v1.4 candidate
restart only the Gate and Terminal services
issue one GATE_FIND request for a known non-secret file
verify returned handoff against local source
issue COPY_TO_GIT using the selected returned path
